meta.title: Kupittaa / Turku Science Park campus - official open geodata extraction (heights, roofs, terrain)

frame.y: up; all elevations here are absolute N2000 metres (Finnish height system, ~mean sea level). Suggested y = h_N2000 - 23.20 (Tykistökatu sidewalk at BioCity main entrance)
frame.transform_used: pyproj EPSG:3877 (ETRS-GK23, Turku native) / EPSG:3067 -> EPSG:4326 -> local formula above; verified: CityGML roof outlines coincide with 2022 true ortho to ~0.2-0.5 m

terrain.summary: Not flat. Gentle general fall from NW (Tykistökatu/Sirkkalankatu 23.2-24.2 m N2000) to SE (Lemminkäisenkatu/Untamonkatu 19.4-19.8 m): ~4.5 m over ~350 m (~1.3 %). Superimposed: split-level plazas and decks (Jussin aukio 23.7/25.3, ICT-City and EduCity decks 25.3-26.6), sunken light-well walkways and garage ramps (to ~20.2), and a railway cutting on the NE edge (tracks ~17-19 m). Elevations are N2000 metres. Suggested scene datum: y=0 at 23.20 m N2000 (Tykistökatu sidewalk at BioCity main entrance) -> y = h - 23.20.

level_features.desc: Jussin aukio is split-level: lower W part ~23.5-23.7 (BioCity E facade, Joki tower N side) and upper E part ~25.3 (toward ICT-City/Eurocity S corner). Level change ~1.6 m along a NE-SW edge from ~(56,2) to ~(81,-20) with a low wall (white coping in 2025 ortho). Main stair ~6.9 x 3.6 m centred (60.8,3.7) just N of the tower; long low steps at (82.5,-19.6). Upper level continues S/E of tower as paved plaza (light beige concrete pavers, square grid) to ICT-City.
level_features.confidence: high (laser 2021 + 2024 spot heights + 2024 base-map steps + 2025 ortho agree)

level_features.desc: Sunken light-well walkway along Electrocity SE facade, approx band from (49,-1) to (62,-11), ~3-5 m wide, floor ~21.6-21.7 (about 2 m below Jussin aukio lower level), low wall/kerb with white coping on plaza side, stairs at both ends centred (50.1,-0.2) and (63.1,-8.9); base map also marks a facade overhang (uloke) along it.
level_features.confidence: medium (laser 2021 floor 21.5-21.7; base map 2024 steps; 2025 ortho shows the strip but cannot show depth)

level_features.desc: BioCity main entrance recess on Tykistökatu: open-to-sky forecourt notch between the BioCity NW block and SW block; street-side line (-35.6,-13.7)->(-28.1,-25.8) = 14.2 m; depth 8.3-12.7 m to the entrance facade (-20.2,-14.4)->(-28.7,-9.1); area ~127 m2; floor 23.10-23.20, FLUSH with sidewalk (no ramp/steps, variation <0.1 m); slender roof-level frame/beam ~1.3 m wide at ~50.0 m N2000 spans the street side; small entrance canopy ~3 x 1.8 m at 26.0 m (~2.8 m clear); main door OSM node 11432405620 at (-24.6,-11.3) under the curved glass atrium vault; 2.5 cm ortho shows light-grey paving with a row of ~0.6 m round fixtures and painted bicycle symbols on the adjacent sidewalk/cycle lane. Also ~3 m deep ground-floor arcades (recessed ground-floor walls, base map "sisennys") along the NW facade (-26.2,-23.1)->(-10.8,-48.1) and SW facade (-28.8,6.2)->(-8.9,34.9); round columns ~0.6 m at the W corner: (-39.9,-5.5), (-38.1,-2.7), (-35.4,-12.9), (-34.7,2.2).

Open courtyard off Tykistökatu between BioCity NE facade and Electrocity SW facade; mouth (-12.7,-50.8)<->(0.3,-71.9) ~24.8 m wide, ~25-30 m deep to the semicircular low roof (centre ~(12,-22), roof ~28.5 m, ~5.4 m above ground); ground 23.3-23.4 (flush with street); asphalt + small grey concrete pavers; bike shelter (~4x3 m) with green racks, small boxes, a parked van (2025). Sunken stair down ~2 m at its SE end along Electrocity (centre (17.9,-43.8), ground 21.3-23.5).
level_features.confidence: high for geometry; interpretation as owner's "syvänne" is a candidate only

level_features.desc: Underground-garage ramp between Eurocity and ICT-City from Joukahaisenkatu (~22.5) descending SW to OSM parking_entrance "BioCity" (node 6774131670) at (84.0,-27.1), floor ~20.2; ~5 m wide between retaining walls (85.2,-23.7)->(103.9,-46.5) and (81.4,-28.8)->(99.0,-50.5); ~2.4 m drop over ~30 m (~8 %).
Road passage under Eurocity (base map tunnel / "ajorata, sillan alla", 2008) at x 79.8-90.5, z -83..-73, plus pedestrian passage under at (76.6..80.2,-76..-73).

Ramp with parallel retaining walls (128.5,151.7)->(139.8,137.7) and (137.7,135.9)->(126.3,150.0), 18 m long, ~2 m apart, to OSM parking_entrance node 4749496225 at (139.0,136.8), ground ~20.3, from the SW surface lot.

EduCity SE/S raised pedestrian deck 25.6-26.6 m over parking (OSM building=parking Joukahaisenkatu 9 at (270.7,132.3)); ~5.7 m above the SW surface lot (19.9) and ~4 m above Joukahaisenkatu (21.5). Stairs from the lot: (206.9,147.7) 10.9x6.4 m, (195.2,138.0), (222.2,140.7); from Joukahaisenkatu: (257.7,88.8) and (252.4,95.5); from DataCity side: (136.0,82.7) and (141.2,86.8) up to ~25.5-25.8. Elevated footway OSM way 1212594779 (layer=1, bridge) around (168,93).

Joki hall roof 26.42 is only ~2.7 m above Jussin aukio lower level (23.7) and ~4.5-5 m above Lemminkäisenkatu (21.3-22.0): hall sits at the Lemminkäisenkatu level, i.e. partly below the plaza. Wide outdoor stair (12.6 x 4.7 m, centre (39.5,28.6)) descends from the BioCity/tower courtyard (~23.5) to the lower walkway on the Joki hall NW side (~21.6). Main Joki entrance on Lemminkäisenkatu 12 B (5.3,53.2) at ~21.3 with a wide shallow step/podium (centre (12.3,52.3)). Tower exit to the upper plaza at (63.8,8.4) ~25.3; external stairs on tower SE side (68.2,22.3)/(71.8,26.4) rise from the upper plaza (~25.3).
level_features.confidence: medium (levels measured; internal floor levels inferred)

level_features.desc: Rail tracks NE of campus in a cutting ~17-19 m; slope toe lines (202.8,-112.1)->(266.6,-20.8) and (269.9,-16.0)->(347.3,89.9); retaining wall along ParkCity E side (223.1,-71.0)->(259.1,-21.5) (86 m) and ParkCity W/N side (181.9,-33.5)->(213.7,-55.5).

street_surface_materials.source: Turku street register WFS GIS:Katualueet (attribute Pintamateriaali), public street areas only (not private plazas/courtyards)

observations_ortho_2025.paving: Public sidewalks: concrete slabs; medians: concrete blocks; carriageways asphalt (register). Jussin aukio upper level and plaza S/E of the Joki tower: light beige concrete pavers in square grid (~0.3-0.4 m units, visible at 2.5 cm/px) with round/square drain covers; lower level N of tower: grey poured concrete with crack lines; wooden boardwalk deck with planters, benches and small lawn in the courtyard between BioCity E facade and the tower (x 30..48, z -25..15). BioCity entrance recess: light grey slabs, row of ~0.6 m round fixtures. Electrocity-BioCity courtyard: asphalt + small grey concrete pavers zone with bike racks.
observations_ortho_2025.green: Core (BioCity-Jussin aukio-ICT-City) is almost entirely hard surface. Green: triangular lawn with ~10 deciduous trees W of Tykistökatu opposite BioCity N part (x -70..-30, z -85..-45, by Dentalia/Villa Medica); lawns and playground courtyards of the Lenkkipolku/Kupittaankuja housing blocks S of Lemminkäisenkatu (x -60..90, z 110..240); Kupittaa park SW corner; grass embankments of the railway cutting NE (x 230..340); green sedum terrace roofs on EduCity SW half; small lawn/planters around the tower courtyard. Trees bare (leaf-off) in the April 2025 image; leafy in the June 2022 true ortho.
observations_ortho_2025.parking: Surface lots: SW of EduCity / SE of DataCity (x ~120..240, z ~120..230, asphalt, white-painted bays, ~70 cars in 2025); E of Joukahaisenkatu by the railway (x ~240..330, z ~0..75, ground ~19.3, ~80 cars); N near Kupittaa station (x ~60..140, z ~-180..-130). Kerbside parallel parking both sides of Lemminkäisenkatu (BioCity-DataCity stretch ~15 cars). Garages: ParkCity (10 storeys, entrances OSM (170.7,-40.6), (201.0,-32.0), (245.2,5.6)); underground ramps (see level_features).
observations_ortho_2025.road_markings: Tykistökatu: 4-6 lanes, white dashed lane lines, solid edge lines, turn arrows, raised median strips (concrete blocks); zebra crossings (white bars) on the legs of the Tykistökatu/Lemminkäisenkatu/Itäinen Pitkäkatu junction (around x -75..-25, z -35..+15) and at the Joukahaisenkatu end; painted white bicycle symbols on the cycle path along BioCity NW frontage. Lemminkäisenkatu: 2 lanes + parking bays + red-asphalt cycle lane (register), white dashed centre line, zebra crossings at about (0,60) (Joki entrance) and (40,100) (DataCity). Joukahaisenkatu: one-way sections, zebra crossing near EduCity NE corner (~(236,50)) with hatched island.
